## Exit criterion
The dependency posture is ruled and the two skeletons are either authored for a real run or
explicitly dispositioned. Until then every `dpop` channel answers `SenderConstraintUnmet` and
event blobs stay unencrypted-at-rest with the honest reason — a recorded state, never a failure.
